title: This Summer Palace bridge glows gold for 20 minutes a year | China Travel Expert
description:
Most of the year it's a plain marble bridge. For about 20 minutes a day around the winter solstice, all 17 of its arches fill with gold.

The Seventeen-Arch Bridge crosses Kunming Lake at Beijing's Summer Palace. Around the winter solstice (about Dec 21), the low setting sun lines up with the arches so the light pours straight through every one of the 17 openings and reflects off the water. Chinese state media report the effect lasts roughly 20 minutes at sunset and only in the two to three weeks around the solstice — so it draws big crowds of photographers each December.

🧭 Expert Tip: come in the two weeks around Dec 21, arrive about an hour before sunset, and set up on the lake's west side for the reflection — clear, cold days give the strongest gold.

颐和园十七孔桥，冬至前后太阳正好穿过所有十七个桥洞，金光满桥——每天只有约20分钟，一年只有这几周。
